root_cause.text: In dpu_runtime_suspend, calling dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0) drops the MMCX voltage rail to MIN_SVS while the core clock frequency remains at its highest rate, creating a voltage/frequency mismatch that can cause instability or system crash when the clock is re-enabled during resume.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "calling dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0) drops the MMCX rail to MIN_SVS while the core clock frequency remains at its original (highest) rate." The patch removes this call from dpu_runtime_suspend to prevent the mismatch.
